correctness.rationale: Six unordered pair states plus merger sink encode the original game by the published localization lemma. The Bob-first least attractor with all reply lengths <k classifies membership; for unrestricted replies a simple path visits at most six nonsingleton vertices, so R6 and Rω agree on nonsingleton outcomes. An independently implemented C++ exact enumeration covered all 256²=65,536 ordered transition pairs, independently reproduced A1..A6=51,520;25,360;22,384 x4, category counts 14,016;26,160;2,976;22,384, and 1,474 symmetry orbits (359;551;62;502) and checked sharp witness A2 not A3. Exhaustive finite enumeration constitutes full domain proof, not sampling.
